# arcane_api_subresource (Ephemeral Resource)

Reads a subresource of an Arcane object with `GET <object>/<subresource>`, without keeping the result in the plan or state. Use it for values such as short-lived tokens, and reference the result from provider configuration or write-only arguments. Requires Terraform 1.10 or later.

The request is sent each time Terraform opens the ephemeral resource. The token needs `get` on `<plural>/<subresource>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read a subresource without keeping the result in the plan or state.
ephemeral "arcane_api_subresource" "runner_token" {
  api_version = "workload.airdrop.pubg.io/v1"
  kind        = "RunnerIDToken"
  namespace   = "default"
  name        = "deploy"
  subresource = "claim"
}

provider "aws" {
  assume_role_with_web_identity {
    role_arn           = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deploy"
    web_identity_token = ephemeral.arcane_api_subresource.runner_token.object.data.idToken
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_version` (String) apiVersion of the parent resource kind, not of the subresource object, such as `sample.arcane.pubg.io/v1`.
- `kind` (String) Kind of the parent resource, not of the subresource object.
- `name` (String) Name of the parent object.
- `subresource` (String) Name of the subresource, as API discovery lists it for the kind, such as `claim` for `runneridtokens/claim`.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the parent object. Required for a namespaced kind, and not allowed for a cluster-scoped one.
- `query` (Map of String) Query parameters to send with the GET request. The API server passes them to the subresource as they are.

### Read-Only

- `object` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Object the server returned, as an object value, as received. Always sensitive.
